svg.aria-label: Monochrome ASCII megastructure: endless pillars, trusses and pipes drawn in text characters. A tiny pixel figure in an amber hard hat walks along a bridge, planning to build a wheel, and stops in front of a colossal wheel that has been turning there all along. Caption: it was already here. Verdict: Adopt.

text.style: font-size:12px;font-family:'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif;letter-spacing:6px

g.text: > level 4092. still nothing here. going to build a wheel.
[ ADOPT ] the wheel already exists. you just didn't know its name.
